smoke_probe.interpretation: The top-level background start succeeded and returned immediately. The non-notifying lower-level probe found one busy/resume-blocked app lane while two lanes probed cleanly, so this is recorded as an app-lane state gap rather than a background-launch failure.

mandatory_future_rule.rule: Future x1 app-lane calls should use --background-watch with --notify when the goal is to send once and keep working while watcher/notifier helpers observe completion.
mandatory_future_rule.completion_boundary: A background start is not completion proof; completion still requires later watcher/notifier receipts or a blocker receipt.
mandatory_future_rule.productive_waiting: After launch, continue source refresh, next-phase planning, guardrail refinement, runner work, and approval packet preparation.
